mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates on future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.2% over two consecutive months signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing inflationary pressure and increasing the likelihood of future monetary easing, which boosts equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average 20-day return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts below 1,650,000 units over two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand and a contraction in residential investment, which triggers a policy response from the Federal Reserve, leading to lower long-term interest rates and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and a rise in the unemployment rate signals a weakening manufacturing sector and labor market stress, indicating an imminent economic slowdown that triggers a dovish policy pivot, boosting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the joint Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the year-over-year CPI inflation rate above 3.5% triggers a hawkish monetary policy response, increasing real interest rates and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is above 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 625,000 million dollars over two consecutive months signals strong underlying demand, which increases corporate earnings visibility and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average 20-day return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in employment growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs per month and a decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals a tight labor market, increasing wage pressures and inflation expectations, which leads to a hawkish Fed response and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market tightness with wage pressure
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized over the past quarter signals a weakening economy, which increases the probability of fiscal or monetary stimulus, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: economic slowdown with policy response risk
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.
